name: @sabeel-institute/ci-tools
description: CI, release and device-test tooling shared by the Sabeel Institute apps

scripts.lint:workflows: rm -rf .rendered && node scripts/workflows.mjs --to .rendered/full --config test/fixtures/full.json && node scripts/workflows.mjs --to .rendered/minimal --config test/fixtures/minimal.json && actionlint -color .github/workflows/*.yml .rendered/*/*.yml
